description: Keep the project journal in sync: on Stop, flag stale tasks + re-render journal.html; on SessionStart, surface any stale tasks. All commands no-op silently when the current project has no *_journal/ directory.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/journal_sync.py" flag 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/journal_sync.py" flag 2>/dev/null || true; python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/journal_sync.py" render 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/journal_sync.py" render 2>/dev/null || true
